extensionName.description: Name of the Safari extension and the title of its toolbar button.

extensionDescription.message: Send the page you are on, or the text you selected, to Doddy. Nothing is saved until you press Save in Doddy.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in Safari settings.

loading.description: Shown briefly while the title, address and selection are read.

selectionLabel.description: Label above the text the user had selected.

noTitle.description: Shown when the page has no title.

notSavedNote.message: Only the title, the address and the text you selected are sent. Nothing is saved until you press Save in Doddy.
notSavedNote.description: Privacy note under the page details.

closeButton.description: Closes the popup after a result is shown.

cantRead.message: Doddy can't read this page. Open a web page and try again. Nothing was sent.
cantRead.description: Shown when the page can't be read, for example on the Safari start page.

resultSent.message: Ready in Doddy. Open Doddy and press Save. It isn't saved yet.
resultSent.description: Result: the clip is waiting in Doddy.

resultFull.message: Doddy already has 20 clips waiting. Open Doddy and save or discard some, then try again. Nothing was saved.
resultFull.description: Result: the clip inbox is full.

resultNotSetUp.message: Sending to Doddy isn't set up in this version of the app. Nothing was saved.
resultNotSetUp.description: Result: this build has no shared folder with the Mac app.

resultNothing.message: There's nothing here Doddy can keep. Nothing was saved.
resultNothing.description: Result: no usable title, address or selection.

resultFailed.message: That couldn't be handed to Doddy. Nothing was saved. Try again.
